notices.html: Fall festival season is wrapping up: Terhune's Fall Family Fun season ended last weekend, and Von Thun's and Battleview's pumpkin picking is likely thinning out or already done for the year. Call ahead before driving to any pick-your-own farm this weekend.

Polar Express train rides have 2026 dates listed for Whippany (Morristown & Erie) and Phillipsburg (Delaware River Railroad), both said to be on sale now, though we couldn't verify the exact dates this week. Check the railroads' own sites or call ahead before booking.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: the Fall Family Fun festival wrapped up last weekend (Oct 31 to Nov 1), so wagon rides, the corn maze and festival admission are done for the year. The farm market and bakery stay open daily, and there's still no apple picking this year after the spring freeze. Call 609-924-2310 to check what's left to pick before you drive over.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: no confirmed update from the farm itself this week, so call 609-448-0629 before you go. Pumpkin picking, the corn maze and hayrides have run into November in past seasons, and apples were this fall's local exception, so it's worth asking what's still available.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: Von Thun's ticketed Fall Festival Weekends typically wrap up by the first weekend of November, so the festival itself may already be over for the year, leaving just the farm market open. Call 732-329-8656 to confirm before you drive over.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: no confirmed update this week. The corn maze, pumpkin picking and hayrides have run into fall in past seasons, though berries are long done. Call the picking hotline at 609-758-8514 or check emerysfarm.com before you go.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: pumpkin season typically wraps up around Halloween here, so picking this late in the fall is uncertain, and there's still no apple picking at all after the spring freeze, the farm's first total crop loss in five generations. Call 732-462-0756 or check their Facebook page before you drive over.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: no confirmed November update from the farm this week. In past years sunflowers, sweet potatoes, popcorn, the corn maze and gem mining have stayed open after apples and pumpkins wind down, so it's worth asking what's still open. Call 609-654-8643 before you go.
blurbs.dinosafari: Still closed for the season: the 2026 Freehold run ended August 16 and no fall or winter return has been announced. No need for a special trip until it's back next summer.
blurbs.sixflags: Fright Fest and the daytime Kids Boo Fest wrapped up last weekend. Six Flags typically reopens for Holiday in the Park in late November, but 2026 dates weren't posted as of this week, so check sixflags.com/greatadventure before planning a visit.
blurbs.diggerland: This weekend: Dig or Treat trick-or-treating is over, but Diggerfest continues through Nov 15, included with general admission. Weekends only this time of year, so it's close to the last easy chance before the park winds down for the season.
blurbs.whalewatch: This weekend: the season normally winds down by fall, but current listings suggest Belmar-area whale watching trips are still running into November this year due to cooler water timing. We couldn't confirm Miss Belmar is still the active boat or operator this season, so call before booking a trip this far out from summer.
blurbs.buckstubing: This weekend: tubing season here typically runs mid-May through October, so this outfit may already be closed for the year. Check rivercountry.net before planning a trip.
